CustomField.description: The number of days the At Risk Assessment has been at a Risk Stage 1 - 4.
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL( Risk_Stage__c, '1. At Risk'),TODAY() - At_Risk_Entered_Date__c, IF(ISPICKVAL( Risk_Stage__c, '2. Notification Confirmed'), TODAY() - At_Risk_Entered_Date__c, IF(ISPICKVAL( Risk_Stage__c, '3. Solution Developed'), TODAY() - At_Risk_Entered_Date__c, IF(ISPICKVAL( Risk_Stage__c, '4. Negotiate'), TODAY() - At_Risk_Entered_Date__c, IF(ISPICKVAL( Risk_Stage__c, '5. Retained (closed)'), Risk_Stage_5_Entered_Date__c - At_Risk_Entered_Date__c, IF(ISPICKVAL( Risk_Stage__c, '6. Terminated (closed)'), Risk_Stage_6_Entered_Date__c - At_Risk_Entered_Date__c, NULL ))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The number of days the At Risk Assessment has been at a Risk Stage 1 - 4.
CustomField.label: Risk Duration (Days)
